construction_materials.expansion: X <Sector> Expansion = Desired Expansion x Min(X Capital Goods Fulfillment, X Construction Materials Fulfillment) for Refinery / Electronics / Power in A and B
construction_materials.not_in_v7_7: regolith extraction energy, interregional trade, lifecycle of the new sectors other than the plants and the regolith mine
construction_materials.known_limit: colony B builds only under stimulus; Mode 31 (transport surge) is the Mode in which B produces construction materials (Mode 30: B only draws its starting stock)
construction_materials.transport: since v7.7.1 shared Transport expansion = Desired x Min(Transport CG Fulfillment, Transport CM Fulfillment), drawing construction materials from A and B by stock shares (switch Transport Construction Materials Enabled)
construction_materials.energy: since v7.7.2 construction-materials processing is the third consumer of the colony energy allocator (switch Construction Materials Energy Enabled); the plan feeding the allocator reads the smoothed stock X Construction Materials Demand Signal (same-step demand closed an algebraic loop through refinery profit)
construction_materials.capital: since v7.7.3 processing capacity is capital: a kernel-v2 construction-materials plant per colony (no finance limit), sized to the smoothed demand signal, expanded from capital goods and construction materials (switch Construction Materials Capital Enabled)

planet_v1.counters: processes 17 + legacy 2; P2 11/6/0/0 (every process capacity is capital); P3 14/2/1/0 (every process but shared transport draws energy from its colony allocator); P4 6/0 (every extraction draws from proven reserves); P5 17/0 (every process declares its labor requirement); P6 4; reversibility 0; mode planet_v1 PASS

capital_goods_capital.plant: kernel-v2 capital-goods plant per colony, no finance limit, sized to the smoothed X Capital Goods Demand Signal stock; expansion from capital goods and construction materials

regolith_capital.mine: simple-capital regolith mine per colony, sized to the smoothed X Regolith Demand Signal stock x 1.25; expansion from capital goods and construction materials; depreciation and retirement of surplus

simple_capital.note: v7.7.5: A/B Regolith Mine; v7.7.6: A/B Ore Mine; v7.7.7: A/B Power Resource Mine (smooth cap on the former uncapped extraction rate); later nodes wrap earlier ones on the capital-goods and construction-materials demand formulas; 23/23 checks each

ore_capital.mine: simple-capital ore mine per colony (start A 70, B 28), sized to the smoothed X Ore Demand Signal stock (following X Positive Desired Mining Rate) x 1.25; replaces X Mining Capacity inside X Effective Mining Capacity; expansion from capital goods and construction materials (0.5 each per unit)

power_resource_capital.mine: simple-capital power-resource mine per colony (start A 1750, B 650), sized to the smoothed X Power Resource Demand Signal stock (start A 1350, B 182.656) x 1.25; caps X Power Resource Extraction Rate smoothly by its capacity (the former rate is X Power Resource Mine Uncapped Output); expansion from capital goods and construction materials (0.02 each per unit)

deposits.layer: per colony and resource (ore, regolith, energy resource): undiscovered resource (planetary scale, named parameter) and proven reserves (named parameter, about 10 years of extraction) stocks; exploration toward 15 years of the smoothed extraction, slowed as the undiscovered stock runs low, paid in capital goods; extraction flows re-sourced from the void to proven reserves; smooth depletion cap

process_energy.layer: per colony: ore mining (1 energy per unit), regolith extraction (10), energy-resource extraction (0.05, EROI 20, priority) and capital-goods production (50) join the colony energy allocator; requests read a 3-day smoothed signal of the pre-energy rate; the rate scales by its own fulfillment; energy-sector own use is served first, the rest share what is left

labor.layer: 17 instances (8 colony processes x A/B + shared transport): labor requirement = output x intensity x automation factor, factor = 1 - (1 - h) * (1 - (1 - level) ^ k), h 0.05, k 1, automation level 0 at start; metal and electronics unit costs read intensity x factor; no labor pool in v1
